title: Menzel stops the Harvard sky survey in 1953

tellings.quote: In 1953, Donald Menzel also stopped the astronomers at Harvard to carry out their very famous sky survey where they were monitoring the entire sky.

as_told.title: Menzel halts the Harvard sky survey from 1953 to 1967

related.note: Both are about Menzel and the 1953 break in Harvard Observatory sky data. This telling says he deleted the data, where the story says he stopped the survey.

plain: In 1953, according to the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, the Harvard astronomer Donald Menzel stopped his colleagues from carrying on their famous sky survey, a photographic watch over the whole sky that had run since the late 19th century. She tells Michels about it on two episodes, and the second time she adds that the survey stayed stopped from 1953 to 1967, roughly 15 years. If that is so, a gap opened in the record of the sky just as UFO reports were peaking.
